trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage and take Disney's Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack, and get settled. Grab a light snack from a nearby convenience store or hotel vending machine.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or skip
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport before boarding
meals.dinner: Quick late-night snack from hotel vending machine or a nearby 24-hour convenience store — budget around $5–$10

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light — rest is essential before a full week at Disney. Pre-download the My Disney Experience app to plan FastPasses and check wait times. Set an alarm for an early start on Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early and head to Magic Kingdom — the crown jewel of Disney World. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane passes for high-demand attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland for classic rides like Peter Pan's Flight and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually around 3:00 PM). Take a midday break at a shaded area or rest at the hotel briefly to recharge — especially important in Florida's June heat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Experience the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show (check schedule on app). Stroll down Main Street USA under the lights. Head back to the resort by 10:30 PM to rest up.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick and affordable breakfast at the hotel or pick up granola bars and fruit from a nearby grocery store packed the night before — budget $5–$8
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — great budget-friendly quick service with options like fish and chips or chicken nuggets. Budget $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of the best budget quick-service spots in Magic Kingdom with burgers, rotisserie chicken, and salads. Budget $12–$16 per person

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free ice water is available at any quick-service counter inside the park. Sunscreen is a must in June. Park tickets must be purchased in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for a full day of exploration. Arrive at rope drop and start with the headliner rides: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Use Lightning Lane early for these popular attractions. Explore Future World and the World Discovery pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon walking through the World Showcase — a loop of 11 country pavilions representing cultures from around the globe. Explore the architecture, art, and street performers. This is completely free to walk through once inside the park. Don't miss the Canada, Japan, and Morocco pavilions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's stunning nighttime show — Luminous: The Symphony of Us (check current schedule). Enjoy the beautiful water and light show over World Showcase Lagoon. Head back to the resort by 10:00 PM.

meals.breakfast: Pack snacks from the hotel or grocery store — granola bars, fruit, juice boxes. Budget $5
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — affordable and delicious quick-service with sandwiches, grain bowls, and rotisserie chicken. Budget $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: Yorkshire County Fish Shop in the UK Pavilion — one of the most affordable and tasty options in World Showcase, offering fish and chips for around $10–$13 per person

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large — comfortable footwear is essential. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan Future World rides in the morning. Stay hydrated — June temperatures in Orlando can reach 90°F+.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios first thing in the morning. Rope drop is critical here — head straight to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive rides in all of Disney). Then hit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run before the park fills up. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then head to the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for thrill seekers. Catch a live show — Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular or Frozen Sing-Along are great family-friendly options with no wait.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular — an outdoor amphitheater show with water, fire, and projections. It's included with park admission and is a Hollywood Studios highlight. Head back to the resort afterward.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — affordable and fun quick-service breakfast with toasted cheese sandwiches and s'mores French toast. Budget $8–$12 per person
meals.lunch: Backlot Express near Star Wars Galaxy's Edge — budget-friendly burgers, chicken strips, and salads. Budget $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: PizzeRizzo in Muppets Courtyard — affordable pizza, pasta, and salads in a fun themed setting. Budget $10–$14 per person

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios can get very crowded — rope drop strategy is essential. Download the virtual queue or Lightning Lane reservations the moment they open (7:00 AM on the app). Consider a mid-afternoon hotel break if traveling with young children.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning — sleep in until 8:00–9:00 AM. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Then explore the Disney Springs shopping and entertainment district, which is FREE to enter with no park ticket required. Browse the shops, enjoy street performers, and soak in the atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue at Disney Springs — visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and check out the outdoor entertainment. Consider a visit to the free Art of Disney gallery. If budget allows, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs and take in the evening ambiance along the waterfront. Head back to the resort for an early bedtime to recharge for the final two park days.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or pack your own — cereal, fruit, yogurt from a grocery store. Budget $5–$8
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own pizza for around $10–$13, one of the most budget-friendly table options at Disney Springs
meals.dinner: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a fun outdoor setting. Budget $13–$17 per person

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is a great free activity day that saves on park ticket costs. Parking at Disney Springs is also free. This is a perfect mid-trip recovery day. Bring a shopping list and stick to a souvenir budget to avoid overspending.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Animal Kingdom — Disney's largest park by land area. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar — arguably the best ride in all of Walt Disney World. Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom — ride Expedition Everest in Asia and Kilimanjaro Safaris in Africa (best experienced in the morning or late afternoon for active animals). Watch the Festival of the Lion King live show — a spectacular Broadway-style performance included with admission.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show or the Tree of Life Awakenings — beautiful projection shows on the iconic Tree of Life. These are free with park admission and are magical at night. Head back to the resort by 9:30 PM.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick snack at the park entrance — Creature Comforts quick service offers affordable pastries, yogurt parfaits, and coffee. Budget $7–$10
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best quick-service meals in all of Disney World with smoked ribs, chicken, and pulled pork at reasonable prices. Budget $13–$16 per person
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy and flavorful bowls with grains, proteins, and vegetables in a stunning Avatar-themed setting. Budget $13–$16 per person

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the early morning and late afternoon — midday heat can be intense in June. The park often closes earlier than other parks, so check hours in advance. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best done early morning when animals are most active.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park for one final morning — Magic Kingdom is highly recommended for a farewell visit. Ride any attractions you missed or loved most. Pick up last-minute souvenirs from Main Street USA shops. Take photos and soak in the magic one last time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is 11:00 AM — request late checkout if needed). Store luggage with the hotel bell service. Spend the early afternoon at Disney Springs for any final shopping or a relaxed lunch. Head to the airport with plenty of time before your departure flight.
day_by_day.evening: Travel home with wonderful memories. Review your Disney photos and plan your next trip!

meals.breakfast: Casey's Corner on Main Street USA in Magic Kingdom — classic American hot dogs and breakfast items at affordable prices. Budget $8–$12 per person
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best value meals near Disney, with hot sandwiches, salads, and soups for $8–$12 per person
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks for the flight home — budget $10–$15

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight for transportation and airport security. Use Disney's resort luggage storage if your flight is in the evening. Take a final walk through your favorite area of the resort and parks to cap off the trip. Total estimated daily food budget per person: $35–$55. Park tickets should be purchased well in advance online for best pricing — multi-day tickets offer the best per-day value.

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation (Mears Connect shuttle or rideshare) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack, and settle into your Beachfront room.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the resort's lobby bar or a nearby 24-hour spot like a Wawa convenience store en route — keep it light after travel

day_by_day.notes: Since you arrive at 22:30, prioritize rest. Confirm your Disney park tickets and MagicBand+ setup via the My Disney Experience app before sleeping. Lay out comfortable park clothes for an early start tomorrow. Hydrate well — Florida summer heat starts Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (park typically opens 8:00–9:00 AM). Hit the most popular rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if available. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure — After lunch, experience Haunted Mansion, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Splash Mountain. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass strategically. Take a mid-afternoon break back at the resort (about 30–45 min away) to cool down and recharge before the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening entertainment spectaculars — watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade and cap the night with the Happily Ever After fireworks show (typically 9:00 PM). The park is often less crowded after dinner, making it perfect for re-riding favorites with shorter waits.

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at the resort before heading out — grab grab-and-go items or a light meal at the resort café to save time
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — excellent mid-range quick service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish platters (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant on Main Street U.S.A. — a classic table-service option with burgers, sandwiches, and comfort food at mid-range prices (~$20–$35 per person); reserve in advance via My Disney Experience

day_by_day.notes: Wear sunscreen and bring refillable water bottles — Disney has free water at quick-service locations. Arrive 30 minutes before park open for the best rope-drop advantage. Download the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT at opening (typically 9:00 AM). Start with Future World / World Discovery and World Nature sections — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane early), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World before the crowds surge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Begin your food and culture tour — sample dishes from Mexico (street tacos at La Cantina de San Angel), Norway (school bread and salmon at Kringla Bakeri), Japan (sushi and gyoza at Katsura Grill), and Morocco (hummus and falafel at Tangerine Café). Take time to browse artisan shops and cultural exhibits in each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Complete the World Showcase loop through France, United Kingdom, Canada, and America pavilions. Enjoy a sit-down dinner at one of the international pavilions, then stay for EPCOT Forever or Luminous the Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — great quick-service breakfast with healthy options like grain bowls and fresh fruit (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.lunch: World Showcase food-stall hopping — budget $25–$35 per person for sampling 4–5 international snacks and small plates across pavilions
meals.dinner: Spice Road Table in the Morocco Pavilion — Mediterranean small plates and flatbreads with a stunning lagoon view, perfect for watching the nighttime show (~$25–$40 per person); reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is best explored over a full day — don't rush the World Showcase. The International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June; check Disney's calendar as it adds extra food booths throughout the park. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as EPCOT covers significant ground.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and Resort Morning — Take a well-deserved slow morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the beachfront amenities, swim in the pool, or take a leisurely walk along the resort's waterfront. This mid-trip recovery day prevents burnout during an intense theme park week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment — Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) in the afternoon. Browse the unique shops including World of Disney, LEGO Store, and NBA Experience. Visit the Coca-Cola Store rooftop for complimentary beverage samples with great views. Explore the entertainment district and enjoy the street performers.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Evening Entertainment — Catch a movie at AMC Disney Springs 24 (if desired) or enjoy live music at various venues throughout the Springs. Explore the Town Center and West Side districts after dark when the atmosphere is especially lively.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy a relaxed meal at the Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant or room service to fully unwind (~$15–$25 per person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs — gourmet burgers with creative toppings at a very reasonable mid-range price (~$15–$18 per person)
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — upscale-casual waterfront dining featuring fresh seafood, steaks, and specialty cocktails; a memorable mid-range splurge (~$35–$55 per person); reservations strongly recommended

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is a great no-ticket option that still delivers Disney magic. Parking is free in the Disney Springs garages. This lighter day is intentionally placed mid-week to recharge energy for the remaining park days. Use this afternoon to also review and adjust Lightning Lane reservations for upcoming park days.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — Arrive at Hollywood Studios at rope drop. Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (book at 7:00 AM via the app). Visit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run while wait times are shortest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Galaxy's Edge and Hollywood Studios — Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (approximately $249.99 per lightsaber; book in advance — a worthwhile splurge for Star Wars fans). Explore the Droid Depot, Oga's Cantina (reservations required), and browse Black Spire Outpost marketplace. Then head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Evening — Experience the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Stay for the spectacular Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show, one of Disney's most impressive nighttime events. The show dramatically lights up the Chinese Theatre with Star Wars imagery.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun theming with great quick-service breakfast items like the Lunch Box Tart and Breakfast Bowl (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — immersive Star Wars-themed quick service with unique dishes like Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken) and Felucian Garden Spread (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café — a beloved Hollywood Studios classic with comfort food like pot roast, fried chicken, and milkshakes in a fun retro diner setting (~$20–$35 per person); reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Book Savi's Workshop and Oga's Cantina reservations well in advance — these are extremely popular and fill up quickly. Rise of the Resistance is the must-do attraction; secure your boarding group or Individual Lightning Lane the moment the park opens at 7:00 AM in the app. Lightsaber building is a premium experience but creates lasting memories for Star Wars fans of all ages.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM). Go directly to Kilimanjaro Safaris for the best wildlife activity — animals are most active in the cooler morning hours. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more on the 18-minute open-air safari vehicle tour.
day_by_day.afternoon: Avatar — Pandora: The World of Avatar — After the safari, head to Pandora. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (book Individual Lightning Lane immediately — this is one of Disney's most in-demand attractions). Experience Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, visually stunning boat ride through a bioluminescent rainforest. Explore the Pandora landscape and grab a Night Blossom drink from Pongu Pongu.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom Evening & Resort Wind-Down — Explore Discovery Island, DinoLand U.S.A., and Asia sections of the park. Ride Expedition Everest and DINOSAUR before the park closes (Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, around 8:00–9:00 PM). Return to the resort for a relaxed evening at the beachfront — enjoy the sunset and a quiet dinner to prepare for your final full day.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the resort or Joffrey's Coffee cart at Animal Kingdom entrance — light breakfast to maximize early morning safari timing
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, noodle bowls, and plant-based options in stunning Avatar theming (~$16–$22 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia — Pan-Asian cuisine including Kobe beef burgers, ahi tuna, and honey chicken in a beautifully themed multi-story restaurant (~$25–$40 per person); reservations recommended, or try Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes for a quicker, cheaper option

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning and late afternoon — midday heat can be intense in June. The park's lush jungle landscaping provides natural shade, but bring a hat and extra sunscreen. Avatar Flight of Passage is a must — the individual Lightning Lane is worth the additional cost given typical 90–120 minute standby waits.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure Morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — Enjoy a final relaxed morning at the resort's beachfront. Take one last swim, pack souvenirs carefully, and check out of your room (or store luggage with the bell desk if your flight is later). Reflect on the week's magical experiences over a leisurely breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney Magic — Return to your favorite park for a few hours using any remaining Lightning Lane passes or park reservations. Alternatively, revisit Disney Springs for any last-minute souvenir shopping at World of Disney or specialty stores. Pick up Disney-exclusive items like Mickey-shaped snacks, spirit jerseys, or custom ears as gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Airport Transfer & Departure — Arrange ground transportation back to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for travel time, check-in, and security. Reflect on an incredible 7-day Disney World adventure as you head home.

meals.breakfast: Chef Mickey's or resort restaurant for a special farewell breakfast — if not previously visited, this character dining experience with Mickey and friends is a magical send-off (~$42–$55 per adult, ~$27–$35 per child); book in advance
meals.lunch: Quick-service farewell meal at your chosen park or Disney Springs — try anything you missed during the week, or revisit a favorite spot
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport — MSY has solid dining options in the terminal including local Florida favorites; budget $20–$30 per person

day_by_day.notes: Check your flight time carefully and plan the resort checkout and airport transfer accordingly. Orlando International Airport recommends arriving 2.5–3 hours early for domestic flights during peak summer travel season. Don't forget to return any rented strollers or equipment, and check your room thoroughly for forgotten items like MagicBands, chargers, and souvenirs. The My Disney Experience app will retain your photos from PhotoPass throughout your trip — download them before your account session expires.

Take time to explore the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront amenities — a morning swim, spa visit, or stroll along the waterfront sets a premium tone. By mid-morning, head to Magic Kingdom for rope drop (or use Early Theme Park Entry if eligible as a Disney resort guest) to tackle Space Mountain, TRON Lightcycle / Run, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure. Enjoy Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane Individual selections for the most in-demand attractions. Grab a mid-afternoon break in the air-conditioned comfort of the Hall of Presidents or browse the charming Main Street shops.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — avocado toast, eggs Benedict, fresh tropical fruit, and specialty coffees at the beachfront restaurant
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland — a table-service, immersive Beauty and the Beast-themed experience with French-inspired cuisine including braised pork, croque monsieur, and decadent desserts
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — a signature dining experience inside Cinderella Castle with stunning park views, prime cuts, fresh seafood, and an enchanting royal atmosphere; book well in advance

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure experience. Disney resort guests enjoy Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes before official opening) — use this to your advantage. Download the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times and Lightning Lane bookings. Wear comfortable premium walking shoes. Sunscreen and a portable fan are essential for June heat.

day_by_day.morning: Begin with an early resort breakfast, then head to Disney's Hollywood Studios for the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Arrive at rope drop to secure a spot at Savi's Workshop — a premium, intimate, and deeply immersive lightsaber-building ceremony (reservations required, ~$250 per person). Then board Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for your first piloting mission.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Galaxy's Edge with Rise of the Resistance — one of the most technically advanced theme park attractions ever built. Explore the Black Spire Outpost marketplace, sip a blue or green milk from Bubo Wamba Family Farms, and browse Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities for premium Star Wars collectibles. Transition to the rest of Hollywood Studios — catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular, Tower of Terror, and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster.
day_by_day.evening: Wind down with the stunning Fantasmic! nighttime lagoon spectacular at Hollywood Studios, featuring Mickey Mouse, beloved Disney characters, and jaw-dropping water, fire, and projection effects. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium spa treatment or cocktails by the beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort beachfront breakfast — Greek yogurt parfaits, smoked salmon platters, fresh-squeezed juices, and a full hot buffet
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge — the only bar inside a Disney park, serving exotic Star Wars-inspired cocktails (alcoholic and non-alcoholic), small bites, and an unforgettable immersive atmosphere; reservations highly recommended
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' premier signature dining restaurant, serving the legendary Cobb Salad, pan-seared salmon, prime beef tenderloin, and classic Hollywood-era desserts in an elegant Art Deco setting

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience. Savi's Workshop reservations must be made well in advance and fill up months ahead. Droid Depot (build-your-own droid, ~$120) is another premium Galaxy's Edge add-on worth considering. Rise of the Resistance is a must — book Lightning Lane Individual at 7:00 AM sharp on the day of your visit.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a relaxed morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort — a beachfront yoga session, spa treatment, or simply lounging by the pool with a premium breakfast. This is a deliberate mid-trip rest day to recharge. Head to EPCOT by late morning to begin the World Showcase Food & Culture Tour, starting with the quieter pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China) before crowds peak.
day_by_day.afternoon: Dive deep into the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour. Sample authentic international cuisine across 11 country pavilions — tacos and margaritas in Mexico, school bread in Norway, Peking duck bao in China, crepes in France, fish and chips in the UK, and gelato in Italy. Catch the stunning Harmonious or its successor nighttime lagoon spectacular rehearsal if visible. Also experience EPCOT's Future World highlights: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure, and Frozen Ever After.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's signature nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of Disney's most ambitious and visually stunning shows. Afterward, browse the artisan shops within the country pavilions for premium souvenirs and gifts.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort pool-deck breakfast — continental spread with pastries, tropical fruits, cold-pressed juices, and espresso drinks
meals.lunch: Graze across World Showcase pavilions as part of the food tour — highlights include the Chefs de France crêpes, La Cantina de San Angel churros and empanadas, and Katsura Grill Japanese cuisine in Japan
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul — EPCOT's most prestigious and intimate fine-dining restaurant, perched above the France pavilion. Chef-driven French haute cuisine with a prix-fixe menu featuring foie gras, lobster bisque, duck confit, and exquisite pastries; extensive wine list; reservations essential

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour experience. EPCOT is best enjoyed at a slower, more leisurely pace than other parks — perfect for a mid-trip day. Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind requires Lightning Lane Individual — book at 7:00 AM. Consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during that season (typically August–November) for an even more elevated culinary experience.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience. Use Early Theme Park Entry to board Kilimanjaro Safaris at sunrise — the golden morning light and cooler temperatures make wildlife viewing exceptional, with lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and zebras most active in the morning hours. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Journey to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Fly on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's crown jewel attraction — book Lightning Lane Individual immediately at 7:00 AM) and float through the bioluminescent Na'vi River Journey. Explore the stunning Pandoran landscape, interact with cast members in character, and shop for unique Pandoran merchandise. Catch the Festival of the Lion King theatrical show — a Broadway-caliber live performance.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the transformation of Pandora at dusk — the bioluminescent plants glow magnificently after dark, creating a magical atmosphere unlike anything else in theme park design. Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (or its current replacement show) before returning to Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium dinner.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort in-room dining — a full premium breakfast delivered to your beachfront suite: eggs to order, smoked meats, pastry basket, fresh fruit, and specialty coffees
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most critically acclaimed theme park restaurant, offering globally inspired fine dining with dishes like whole-fried sustainable fish, tandoori lamb chops, and artisanal desserts in a beautifully curated gallery-like setting
meals.dinner: Nomad Lounge (adjacent to Tiffins) for premium craft cocktails and small plates, followed by a private resort dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature beachfront restaurant — fresh seafood, premium steaks, and Mediterranean-inspired dishes under the stars

day_by_day.notes: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience. Avatar Flight of Passage is the single most sought-after Lightning Lane Individual in all of Walt Disney World — set an alarm for 7:00 AM and book immediately. Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM) — plan accordingly. The park is stunning in the morning; the safari is the non-negotiable first activity.

day_by_day.morning: A premium leisure morning at Aegean Bliss Resort — indulge in a couples' or family spa treatment, a private cabana by the beachfront pool, or a guided water activity. This morning is intentionally unscheduled to allow full relaxation and personalization. Optionally, return to a favorite park for any missed attractions or experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Disney Springs for the Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening (starting in the afternoon). Explore the four neighborhoods — The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Browse premium retailers including UNIQLO, Levi's, Kate Spade, Alex and Ani, and the massive World of Disney store. Visit The VOID (if operational) for hyper-reality Star Wars experiences, or catch a film at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy Disney Springs' vibrant evening atmosphere — live musicians perform throughout the outdoor promenade, and the waterfront setting is beautiful at night. This is a no-admission-required evening of pure entertainment, dining, and leisure.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort signature restaurant — a premium Sunday brunch-style spread with made-to-order omelets, Belgian waffles, smoked salmon, charcuterie, mimosas, and Bloody Marys
meals.lunch: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — a stunning multi-deck restaurant aboard a permanently docked steamboat, serving premium seafood including Maine lobster, Alaskan king crab, oysters on the half shell, and fresh fish preparations with sweeping waterfront views
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Orlando restaurant offering Pan-Asian cuisine at its finest: Peking duck, sushi platters, whole fish preparations, and innovative cocktails in a dramatic two-story setting; one of the best restaurants in all of Orlando

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening experience. Disney Springs is free to enter and offers free parking — no park ticket required. It's an ideal wind-down day after four intense park days. Make dinner reservations at Morimoto Asia well in advance — it is consistently one of the hardest tables to get in the Disney Springs area. Consider a sunset cocktail at Terralina Crafted Italian or The BOATHOUSE for waterfront views.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final premium breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — savor every moment of the beachfront view. Take a last leisurely walk along the resort waterfront or a final dip in the pool. Pack, check out, and arrange luxury resort-to-airport transfer. Optionally, visit Disney Springs one final time for any last-minute souvenir shopping before heading to the airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart for Orlando International Airport with ample time. Use the resort's bell services for luggage assistance and enjoy a smooth, premium departure experience. Reflect on an extraordinary week at Walt Disney World.
day_by_day.evening: Travel home with magical memories, premium souvenirs, and the satisfaction of a perfectly curated Disney World luxury experience.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss — go all out with the full premium spread: eggs Benedict, fresh-carved fruit, pastries, specialty lattes, and a celebratory glass of champagne or fresh juice
meals.lunch: Quick-service or casual dining at Disney Springs if time permits before airport transfer — Earl of Sandwich or Chicken Guy! for a relaxed, no-fuss final meal
meals.dinner: Airport dining or onboard flight service

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight departure for Orlando International Airport, especially during peak summer travel season. Disney resort guests may be eligible for resort airline check-in services — confirm with the resort concierge. Ship any large souvenir purchases home via the resort's package shipping service to avoid baggage fees. Save your My Disney Experience memories, photos, and MagicBand data before departing.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
